breadcrumbs.name: Hotel Key Card Sample Planning Guide

summary: This guide helps hotel teams request better key card samples by tying the first sample set back to lock compatibility, material priorities, encoding needs and rollout timing.
Use these short answers to decide whether this page matches the project before moving into the detail.
The best sample set answers one decision at a time instead of covering every possible card option.

faq.question: How many hotel key card samples should a first round include?
faq.answer: Usually only a control sample plus a small number of realistic alternatives. Too many variants often slow the project without creating a clearer decision.

faq.question: What speeds up a hotel sample request most?
faq.answer: A current card sample or clear lock reference, together with notes on encoding, material preference, print needs and rollout timing, usually produces the best first shortlist.
